name: answer-citing-one-document
why: An answer that cites a single passage, so the run observes no pair of documents at all. The E7 counterpart of answer-cited: what most narrow questions actually look like, and the case whose suggestion section is empty.

provenance.why_not_recorded: Nothing on this path has been called for real yet outside E6's measurement run, which recorded no single-citation answer. Constructed, and it proves only that a run citing one document proposes nothing.
